subject: error in preparing the summary statistics for GWAS

messages.author: 1ade312b2b5688ec
messages.subject: error in preparing the summary statistics for GWAS
parts:
Hi All,

I met an error when I ran the step3: Prepare the summary statistics for GWAS. Everything is fine except for the final step. It successfully finished running but returned an error finally. The error is: 

Error in flush(log.file) : object 'log.file' not found
Calls: sumstats -> flush
Execution halted

I'm wondering what does this error mean?

Thanks for your help.

Best,
Zihang

messages.author: d6d83e22ef3ba9f1
messages.subject: Re: error in preparing the summary statistics for GWAS
parts:
Hi Zihang, 

Thanks for bringing this up! I had added a line of code a few weeks back to the sumstats function suppress a benign warning about the .log file being "closed" that was causing an error when run in parallel. I've put in a fix if you want to redownload the package, restart R, and retry running your code. Of course let us know if you are still running into any issues. 

Best, 
  Andrew
